tagline: The intro of an editorial listing page (gh#1437): an optional `EditorialBreadcrumb`, then the ruled kicker, the page's one h1, one lead line, and an action at the end of the title row. Geometry: `--editorial-page-header-*` (block padding, title size/leading/margins, lead size/measure, kicker size/colour, row display — `block` stacks the action under the copy on a phone).
usage: DO put it in an EditorialSection on a `flow="sections"` page, so it shares the landing column.
DON'T also give the page a PageContainer title — the header owns the page's one h1.
